items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: I could do a step that he taught me, yes, I could do that.

ctx.x: Yes. Pickin' John Steele, you know -- Bud Powell, and some gentleman from the Ted Rayburn Orchestra, an alto saxophone player -- I think he name was Ross.
Pickin' John Steele -- what kind of tap dancing did he do?
